title: Signals Museum of Information Explosion

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: SIGNALS Museum showcases the scientific principles, history, and technological advancements associated with the evolution of communication technology. The museum offers hands-on experiences and diverse exhibits that make learning about communication technology engaging and memorable. SIGNALS Museum Field Trips are designed to challenge and educate students in the middle and high school age range along with adults of all ages. The exhibits have been created on a level that may be too advanced for the typical elementary and preschool student. As such, we recommend field trips primarily for grades 5th -12th. services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: ​​Our Exhibitions unfold a captivating narrative about the transformative journey of communication and information technology, revealing how it has allowed humanity to forge connections across vast distances. Through these immersive exhibits, we invite you to discover a fresh perspective on the profound impact of history on our methods of sharing information. Visitors will be entranced by a kaleidoscope of stunning antiques and artifacts, dynamic interactive digital exhibits, and Augmented and Virtual Reality (AR/VR) experiences, all curated to provide an engaging, enlightening, and exhilarating adventure.
